settings.calibration: raw only for W0/W1/W2; no temperature fitting; reuse raw W0 predictions and thresholds

clip.head: StandardScaler then LogisticRegression(C=1, liblinear, max_iter=2000, random_state=20261018)
clip.local: four mean-pooled normalized features from 56px PatchShuffle views; seeds 202610220..202610223
clip.precision: FP16 encoder on CUDA as Round 6; embeddings normalized in FP32

settings.epoch_selection: Maximum mean selection AUROC over clean/jpeg70/resize05; exact tie retains earliest epoch
settings.evaluation: Evaluation is unchanged from Step C: conditions clean/jpeg70/jpeg50/resize05 applied to the ORIGINAL evaluation images (do not format-match evaluation images); domains SD15 selection, ADM dev, BigGAN dev.

format_match.draw: Rejection sampling: SHA256 UTF-8 stepD|seed|source_id|counter, big-endian integer, reject >= 2^256 - (2^256 mod 36), q=60+(integer mod 36). Counter starts at 0. No label or epoch input.
format_match.pipeline: Decode original with EXIF transpose to RGB, JPEG encode once at native size with Pillow subsampling=2, optimize=False, progressive=False; decode RGB; then unchanged Step C original profile and condition.

settings.geometry: Unchanged Step C original: ImageOps.fit 224x224 BICUBIC; then inherited condition; CLIP or ImageNet normalization.
settings.implementation_lock: Separate stepD_whole_image/implementation.json binds this pre-training protocol and new implementation hashes before any real training.
settings.isolation: No reserved_test_manifest.jsonl access, no reserved-test image access. Reuse only Step C allowlisted original caches read-only, guard before any cache/image/feature access. Do not use gate-fit or calibration partitions.
limitations: real images become double-compressed, fakes single-compressed. Reporting JPEG conditions add further compression to original images, not format-matched copies.
Native resolution and prior compression history remain confounded; this intervention does not establish sole causation. W1-W0 is architecture-matched; W2-W0 also changes architecture.

SD15 selection shares image identities with tuning, so reporting is optimistic, not independent test evidence. ADM/BigGAN are previously inspected development domains. Three seeds share the fitting pool and development images; SD is descriptive, not a confidence interval.
settings.outputs: results/round7/stepD_whole_image/ and artifacts/round7/stepD_whole_image/ only; immutable outputs, atomic publication, checkpoint resume
settings.question: is the global branch's below-chance AUROC on JPEG-compressed ADM/BigGAN caused by the training-set format confound (real = JPEG, fake = PNG), and does format-matched training remove it without a clean-image cost?

report.a: per-condition AUROC, balanced accuracy and real-FPR, each seed plus mean ± SD;
report.aggregation: Each domain and condition separately; arithmetic mean and sample SD (ddof=1), three run seeds. Paired differences computed within seed for each metric. Also clean SD15 AUROC/BA/FPR costs vs W0.
report.b: paired within-seed differences W1−W0, W2−W0 and W2−W1 per condition;

resnet.checkpoint: Initialization plus every completed epoch; model, optimizer, scheduler, Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG and history; exclusive filenames; resume latest valid checkpoint
resnet.epoch_selection: Maximum mean selection AUROC over clean/jpeg70/resize05; exact tie retains earliest epoch
resnet.normalization: ImageNet mean/std after identical RGB geometry/degradation; CLIP uses CLIP mean/std
resnet.oom_policy: Only CUDA OOM permits batch reduction (halving); rollback whole failed epoch to prior checkpoint, restore RNG/optimizer/scheduler and retry. Record batch changes. Never silently reduce for another reason.
resnet.schedule: CosineAnnealingLR T_max=10 eta_min=0; step once after each epoch

settings.selection_tuning: Format-matched selection views ONLY for thresholds and epoch choice. Apply inherited clean/jpeg70/resize05 conditions AFTER format matching and original-profile preprocessing; JPEG50 report-only. No development tuning.
success_criteria: clean ADM and clean BigGAN AUROC drop <= 0.02 vs W0;
settings.success_implementation: For W1 and W2 separately: PASS/FAIL for ADM JPEG mean, clean ADM drop and clean BigGAN drop per seed; joint pass requires all criteria in all 3 seeds. No criteria changed after results. Thresholds 0.50 and 0.02 inclusive; numerical tolerance 1e-12 only.
settings.threshold: Per model/profile/calibration/initialization, pooled selection Youden J over clean/jpeg70/resize05; ties closest probability threshold .5 (Round 6); fixed across all four reporting conditions
settings.training_partition: expert_fit only; one format-matched clean view per source; fixed quality across epochs

variants.W0: the existing Step C global CLIP expert. Reuse its saved predictions; do not retrain.
variants.W1: format-matched frozen CLIP global expert. Before preprocessing, every training image (real and fake) is JPEG re-encoded once at a quality drawn uniformly from 60–95, with a deterministic draw per (seed, source_id). Same logistic head settings as W0. The selection partition gets the same deterministic treatment.
variants.W2: format-matched ResNet-50. The same W1 training input, with the Step C ResNet-50 settings otherwise unchanged (AdamW 1e-4, wd 1e-4, batch 32, 10 epochs, cosine, selection-based epoch choice, checkpoint/resume).
